product_one_liner.value: Aviatrix provides enterprises with cloud-network security that enforces zero-trust, identity-aware communication between workloads.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes zero-trust, identity-aware workload communication, while the homepage explicitly identifies enterprises as the audience. Sources: https://www.aviatrix.com/products and https://aviatrix.com/

pricing_page.notes: A public Aviatrix Clearance pricing page exists. Source: https://aviatrix.ai/clearance/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Aviatrix's customer-success page names both organizations in customer stories, rather than as partners or investors. Source: https://aviatrix.com/featured-customers | named_customers.0: Anheuser-Busch InBev appears in a customer-success story at https://aviatrix.com/featured-customers. | named_customers.1: Better appears in a customer-success story at https://aviatrix.com/featured-customers.

employee_band.notes: Aviatrix's company profile explicitly lists 201–500 employees, matching the requested band. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/6440846

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile explicitly identifies Santa Clara, California, as headquarters. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/6440846 | hq_country: The company profile identifies headquarters in Santa Clara, California, and gives its primary address in the US. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/6440846

founded_year.notes: The company's anniversary retrospective explicitly says its founder launched Aviatrix in 2014. This primary-source account is preferred over a conflicting secondary founding-year record. Source: https://aviatrix.ai/blog/aviatrixs-10th-anniversary-a-decade-of-innovation-leadership-and-growth-2

eng_blog.notes: Two substantive technical posts were found: Susan Hinrichs explains Aviatrix's policy-to-enforcement implementation, and Technical Marketing Engineer Tim McConnaughy explains the product's data-plane architecture and IPsec orchestration. The second is hosted on the main blog rather than the separate engineering publication, making classification somewhat interpretive. Sources: https://engineering.aviatrix.com/network-security-policy-to-enforcement-with-aviatrix-892fd66ac719 and https://aviatrix.ai/blog/tech-deep-dive-aviatrix-data-plane/

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal links to getting-started and transit-gateway guides, security and monitoring documentation, and an API reference, exceeding a single FAQ. Source: https://docs.aviatrix.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The complete readable job board lists 16 openings. None has a qualifying AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied-scientist, research-scientist, NLP, LLM or computer-vision title. Source: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/aviatrix/jobs

model_provider.notes: Aviatrix explicitly says its Microsoft Security Copilot integration uses OpenAI to streamline security incident response. This establishes a publicly named provider, not a claim that every Aviatrix AI feature uses it. Source: https://aviatrix.com/blog/take-your-cloud-security-to-the-next-level-aviatrixs-integration-with-microsoft-security-copilot

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: Aviatrix's Trust Center publicly lists SOC 2, ISO 27001 and GDPR. Only these named items from the requested set are included. Source: https://trust.aviatrix.com/ | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 is named on https://trust.aviatrix.com/. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001 is named on https://trust.aviatrix.com/. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR is named on https://trust.aviatrix.com/.

Source: https://aviatrix.ai/newsroom/press-release/aviatrix-raises-200-million-in-funding-led-by-tcv-elevating-the-cloud-networking-leaders-valuation-to-2-billion/ | funding_amount_usd: The official announcement reports $200 million in Series E funding. raised_18mo.notes: The latest disclosed round identified was September 2021, before the May 2025 start of the requested 18-month window; no later financing was found in the funding history or announcement searches. Source: https://aviatrix.ai/newsroom/press-release/aviatrix-raises-200-million-in-funding-led-by-tcv-elevating-the-cloud-networking-leaders-valuation-to-2-billion/

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board includes Strategic Account Executive – United States, with a live application link at https://aviatrix.com/careers/?gh_jid=4580596005. Board source: https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/aviatrix/jobs

launched_6mo.notes: Aviatrix announced Clearance on October 26, 2026, within the six-month window. It is a new workload-containment offering, not merely a bug fix or interface adjustment. Source: https://aviatrix.ai/newsroom/press-release/aviatrix-launches-clearance

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Unknown: the leadership roster lacks appointment dates. Mark Anthony's profile lists an Aviatrix VP role ending in September 2026 but also retains a current Aviatrix title, so a company departure cannot be established unambiguously. Neither true nor false is sufficiently supported. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/mark-anthony-a1586 and https://aviatrix.com/leadership
